name: slack-approval-block-action
description: M18 G1 in-chat approvals over Slack block_actions. An Owner taps Approve (callback carried under `content.callback.value`): the router-side interceptor resolves the pending approval via the same DB path the CLI uses and edits the card. An un-privileged sender's tap on another approval is refused with a 'not authorized' reply and the approval stays live. Neither tap writes an inbound row.
